title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Screen Time
caption:
What Scripture actually says about your screen time. It's not a detox problem. It's a war.

Stop calling it a habit. Name it a battle. Ephesians 6 says the fight is against powers you can't see, not just your willpower. A detox ends after a week. A war gets fought daily.

Take every thought captive before it takes you (2 Corinthians 10:5). Guard the first hour like it decides the other twenty-three. And fight it with a brother, not just an app limit. Tell one man the real number this week.
